## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit subject (`type(scope): description`).
- [ ] Every new behaviour has a test; `npm run quality` passes locally with 100% coverage.
- [ ] No secret, token, vault item or real customer data appears in code, fixtures, logs or screenshots.
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/spec`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) is updated in this PR, not a follow-up.
- [ ] Any new dependency is justified in the description (purpose, size, transitive count, alternatives).
